bullets.id: Emas membuka pekan Fed tanpa pemulihan: Reuters mencatat spot $3.986,16 di awal sesi Asia Senin, dan Trading Economics menunjukkan sekitar $3.993,79, masih di dekat level terendah lebih dari tiga bulan. Dalam sebulan emas turun 2,95%, dan kini sekitar 28,8% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 pada Januari 2026.
bullets.en: Gold opened Fed week without a rebound: Reuters had spot at $3,986.16 early in Monday’s Asian session, and Trading Economics shows about $3,993.79, still near its lowest in more than three months. Gold is down 2.95% on the month and now about 28.8% below its $5,608.35 record from January 2026.

bullets.id: Minyak sedikit mereda: Brent turun 1,87% ke $114,54 dan WTI turun 2,13% ke $101,07. Yield Treasury 10 tahun di 4,967% dan indeks dolar di 101,60. Pasar memperkirakan Fed menahan suku bunga di 3,75–4,00% (peluang sekitar 90%), tetapi peluang kenaikan Desember sekitar 80%. Lima bank sentral besar memutuskan pekan ini, dan Bank of Canada serta RBNZ diperkirakan bisa menaikkan suku bunga.
bullets.en: Oil eased a little: Brent fell 1.87% to $114.54 and WTI fell 2.13% to $101.07. The 10-year Treasury yield is at 4.967% and the dollar index at 101.60. Markets expect the Fed to hold at 3.75–4.00% (about 90% odds), but put the odds of a December hike at about 80%. Five major central banks decide this week, with the Bank of Canada and the RBNZ priced for a possible hike.

bullets.id: Agenda: keputusan Fed Rabu 28 Oktober pukul 14.00 waktu AS (Kamis 01.00 WIB), lalu PCE September dan PDB kuartal III pada Kamis 29 Oktober pukul 08.30 waktu AS (19.30 WIB). Level yang dipantau: resistance $4.021–4.039 dan $4.075; support $3.963 dan $3.946, dengan target turun $3.890. PCE dingin membuka $4.150, sinyal kenaikan Desember mengarah ke $3.890.
bullets.en: Agenda: the Fed decision on Wednesday, October 28 at 2 pm US time (01:00 WIB Thursday), then September PCE and third-quarter GDP on Thursday, October 29 at 8:30 am US time (19:30 WIB). Levels watched: resistance at $4,021–4,039 and $4,075; support at $3,963 and $3,946, with a downside target of $3,890. A cool PCE opens $4,150; a December hike signal points to $3,890.

bullets.id: Harga Antam 1 gram tidak berubah dari Jumat di Rp2.540.000, tetapi turun Rp34.000 dalam sepekan. Buyback tetap Rp2.335.000 (spread Rp205.000, sekitar 8,1%). Galeri24 di Rp2.467.000 (buyback Rp2.326.000, spread sekitar 5,7%) dan UBS di Rp2.491.000 (buyback Rp2.301.000, spread sekitar 7,6%), keduanya tidak berubah dari akhir pekan.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price is unchanged from Friday at Rp2,540,000, but down Rp34,000 on the week. Buyback stays at Rp2,335,000 (a Rp205,000 spread, about 8.1%). Galeri24 is at Rp2,467,000 (buyback Rp2,326,000, spread about 5.7%) and UBS at Rp2,491,000 (buyback Rp2,301,000, spread about 7.6%), both unchanged from the weekend.
